archetype: Organic & Earthy (Warmth + Tech) - Trust, growth, and approachability.

scale_rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-bold text-stone-900
scale_rules.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-bold text-stone-900

primary.description: Deep Emerald (Hijau UMKM) - Represents trust, growth, and local business.

accent.description: Warm Terracotta/Orange - Action, energy, local warmth. Used strictly for CTAs and highlights.

background.description: Warm Stone 50 - Avoids harsh stark white. Creates an approachable, earthy feel.

surfaces: Glassmorphism: Use for sticky nav. `bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-stone-200/50`. Never raw transparent.
Neumorphism (Tactile): For feature Bento cards. Flat white background, 1px subtle border (`border-stone-200`), hover: slight lift `-translate-y-1` + `shadow-xl shadow-stone-200/50`.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Generous rounded corners (`rounded-2xl` or `rounded-3xl` on major containers) to feel friendly and human.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use `p-8` to `p-12` for cards, `py-24` or `py-32` for sections.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (`border-stone-200`) on structural elements to create crisp, clean separation without heavy drop shadows.

layouts.general: Single-page, scroll storytelling. Mobile-first responsive grids.
layouts.nav: Sticky glassmorphism header. Left: TuntasUMKM Logo (Text + Icon). Right: Hidden on mobile (hamburger), Desktop shows links + CTA.
layouts.hero: Asymmetric split. Left: Outcome-driven headline ('Agen AI yang nggak cuma jawab, tapi bertindak'), sub-copy, Dual CTAs (Primary Terracotta, Secondary Outline). Right: Code-built UI mockup of a chat interface floating over a subtle abstract green texture. Use 'Tetris Grid' mode (grid-cols-12, left col-span-5, right col-span-7).
layouts.problem_statement: 3-column grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`) with generous `gap-12`. Highlight the core stat ('64% Waktu Terbuang') as a massive typographic element (`text-7xl font-light`).
layouts.how_it_works: Visual 7-stage pipeline (Intake -> Understanding -> Grounding -> Tool Call -> Approval -> Response -> Analytics). Create a horizontally scrolling or wrapped sequence of numbered cards connected by thin dashed lines.
layouts.features: Bento Grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6`). Mix spans (e.g., `col-span-12 md:col-span-8`, `md:col-span-4`, `md:col-span-6`) to break symmetry. Each cell must have an icon, title, short desc, and a mini visual/UI snippet.
layouts.differentiator: Grid Borders ('The Technical Look'). Clean comparison table (Chatbot Biasa vs TuntasUMKM). Use Lucide Check/X icons. Highlight the TuntasUMKM column with a subtle green tint (`bg-emerald-50`).
layouts.demo_preview: Massive central section. Build actual HTML/Tailwind mockups for the chat interface and analytics dashboard. Make it interactive if possible (e.g., hover effects on the mock data). Do not use an image for the UI.
layouts.target_segments: 3 Use case cards (Warung, Fashion, Elektronik). Each featuring a highly relevant photo from the media list with a gradient overlay and text at the bottom.
layouts.cta: Dark section (Deep Emerald `bg-emerald-900`) with a 'Crystal Glass' styled form card (`bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md`) for the mock email waitlist.

motion.scroll: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fade-up (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}`) and stagger-children for grid items.
motion.micro: Hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons scale down (`active:scale-95`). Cards lift up slightly on hover.

components.name: Button
components.instruction: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`). Primary: `bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white`. Secondary: `bg-white border-2 border-stone-200 hover:border-emerald-900 text-stone-900`.

components.name: Card
components.instruction: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for complex layouts rather than rigid shadcn Card to allow overlapping. Standard styling: `bg-white rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 p-8`.

components.name: Input
components.instruction: Shadcn input with `rounded-full` or `rounded-xl`, high contrast border (`border-stone-300`), and a sharp focus ring (`focus-visible:ring-emerald-600 focus-visible:border-emerald-600`).

images.description: Vibrant abstract green image. Use as a subtle, low-opacity (`opacity-10`) background behind the right-side hero UI mockup.
Smiling barista in a stylish cafe. Use as the background for the 'Warung Online / F&B' segment card.
Modern clothing store. Use as the background for the 'Fashion Boutique' segment card.
Electronics store. Use as the background for the 'Toko Elektronik' segment card.

icons: lucide-react. Standardize stroke-width to 1.5 or 2 for consistency.
instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: `yarn add framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`.
FONTS: Import 'Outfit' (weights: 400,600,700) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (weights: 400,500,600) from Google Fonts in index.css. Apply them globally.

CODE-BUILT MOCKUPS: The user explicitly requested 'Code-built UI mockups'. In the Hero and Demo Preview sections, construct the Chat UI and Dashboard visually using divs, flexbox, and Tailwind classes. Do NOT just insert an image placeholder.
BENTO GRID (Features): Ensure asymmetry. Create a 12-column grid and mix widths. For example, top row has a span-8 and a span-4 card. Bottom row has three span-4 cards.
TESTING: Add `data-testid` to all CTAs, navigation links, and the waitlist form.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Emerald-900 and Orange-600 passes WCAG AA guidelines.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (`focus-visible`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific properties (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Lucide React.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or placeholder text for images. Use the provided image URLs exclusively.
